what_this_commits: The V3 planted-correlation control arm for EXP-HQC-982268 (TASK-20260806-e1700f): design.md (pre-registered closed-form marginal law and rejection-sampling construction, written before any data was generated), planted_arm_v3.py (imports stage_a.py's decode_blocks and measure.py's estimator/jackknife code directly, sha256-pinned), the main-run MATCH/MISMATCH results (planted_results.json), the separate detection-rate experiment's raw results (detection_results.json) and report (detection_rate_report.md), run_manifest.yaml, and run logs for both authorized runs.
ordering: Committed and verified BEFORE either independent review task (TASK-20260806-cdc631 validator, TASK-20260806-7008de red-team) is dispatched.
status_of_contents: OBSERVATIONS ONLY, per the executor's role. MAIN RUN: T = 500,000 trials, genuinely heterogeneous rejection-sampled content (mean 2.382 draws per accepted block; a 10,000-block sample showed zero duplicates, confirming the ensemble is not a disguised small fixed set). All 17 tested cells (k = 2..18) MATCH the closed-form planted value within the 3-jackknife-SE band. 671.6 of 1000 allocated core-seconds used. DETECTION-RATE RUN: a boundary-shift ('read-one-early') flip rate measured four independent ways, clustering tightly -- interior-position unconditional 10.4662% (Wilson 95% CI [10.42%, 10.51%], T=2,000,000), margin<=4-conditioned 20.1175% (CI [20.03%, 20.20%]), full-ensemble global off-by-one 10.5088% (5.6M position observations), full-ensemble last-block-early 10.685% (T=100,000). These are close to, and roughly 1.03-1.19x, the Red Team's independent EV-HQC-9a30d3 baselines (unconditional 8.8%, margin-conditioned 19.6%), and roughly an order of magnitude below V2's deterministic 100%. The executor notes this arm's accepted-content margin distribution (mean 9.79, 44.2% at margin<=4) is measurably closer to the decision boundary than the Red Team's unconditioned population (mean 10.70, 38.8%) -- offered as a candidate, not asserted-causal, explanation for the small unconditional-rate gap, and flagged explicitly for the Red Team's rejection-sampling-bias review. 274.7 of 800 allocated core-seconds used; 946.3 of 1800 total. Fail-closed abort demonstrated (corrupted measure.py sha256 pin caused the script to abort with exit 1 and write no output, then reverted and re-verified). No interpretation of what this implies for OPEN-6 or EV-HQC-9a30d3 is offered here -- that is reserved for the Validator and Red Team.
claim_boundary: Toy. Two authorized runs (main MATCH/MISMATCH check, separate detection-rate experiment), one seed family, no replication. This is an instrument check, not a measurement of HQC: no statement about A17, HQC's decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set. Whether this arm closes, partially closes, or leaves open OPEN-6 -- and whether it constitutes evidence that the control-arm approach itself has reached a ceiling -- is not decided by this snapshot and is the explicit deliverable of both pending reviews.
